summary: The Bodcau tower near old Bellevue was standing in November 1946 and was torn down in 2009 for state park facilities.

facts.status_note: Wikipedia says it was torn down in 2009; the Forest Lookouts page records it as removed.

events.note: Named in a November 1946 report as one of three fire towers in Bossier Parish
Torn down for construction of additional state park facilities, per Wikipedia

notes_for_editor: No build date, staffing or fire history found. The 1946 report is the earliest evidence of the tower in the sources. Wikipedia gives the 2009 removal date; the Forest Lookouts page says only Removed. No source describes the site today.
